lines.t: What is life without love?
What is love without love?
Free will to choose love
Da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da Life with no love is just empty time
Breath in the chest but no spark inside Love with no choices, just force lines
No heart behind it, just surface lies Free will to choose who to hold close
Free will to say yes or no Love stands on the ground that you chose
Not forced, not bought, just freely known
What is life without love?
What is love without the free will?
Choose love
Again and again
That's the only real thing
If you never choose, it's not really love
If you can't say no, you can't say yes
Real love is a choice you walk in each day
Not a flash, not a trend, just a steady stay
Life with love and love with choice
Heart in the hands of its own will
No need to fake it, no need to pretend Free will to choose love, that's the real win
What is life without love?
What is love without the free will?
Choose love
Again and again
Yeah, and that's the only real thing
Free will to choose love
Free will to choose love
Da da da da da, da da da da da da da
